requirements.title: 正式结果只能由实操证据和真人Gate产生
requirements.behavior: FormalResult requires PRACTICE evidence, HUMAN_EVALUATION evidence and a signed HumanGate; reading, click, AI, self-attestation and points are insufficient.

requirements.title: 共享提交审核返工通过闭环
requirements.behavior: Every formal assignment follows AVAILABLE to IN_PROGRESS to SUBMITTED to IN_REVIEW to NEEDS_REVISION or PASSED; resubmission creates a new immutable SubmissionVersion.
acceptance: one revision cycle and one pass per module
old submission and evaluation remain readable

requirements.title: AI只作建议
requirements.behavior: AI may self-check, initial-score, summarize and flag risk; all AI output is labeled advisory with purpose, model and prompt version.
acceptance: formal mutation path rejects AI actor

requirements.title: 激励与能力双账本
requirements.behavior: Points, XP, badges and rank are append-only incentive facts referencing approved contribution events and never mutate evidence, evaluation, gate or people conclusions.

requirements.title: 高影响结论可解释可申诉
requirements.behavior: High-impact gates include fixed evidence, rubric version, human reason, signer, appeal policy/window and append-only replacement lineage.
acceptance: replacement gate references appeal and prior gate

requirements.title: 唯一人员身份与私密邀请
requirements.behavior: A controlled invite binds one real identity to one organization-scoped person; revoked or consumed links cannot be reused.

requirements.title: 四模块统一首页与唯一下一行动
requirements.behavior: The learner home exposes exploration camp, newcomer village, AI academy and delivery guild and presents one clear current action before technical metadata.
acceptance: 3 of 3 users find next action without explanation
mobile and desktop first screen usable

requirements.title: 版本化内容任务Rubric
requirements.behavior: Published content, TaskVersion and RubricVersion are immutable and bind source, owner, version, visibility, sensitivity and effective time.
acceptance: new version does not rewrite historical assignment

requirements.title: 角色对象目的时间四维授权
requirements.behavior: Authorization requires organization, role, explicit object assignment, purpose and active time window.
acceptance: cross-person and cross-module enumeration is blocked

requirements.title: 运营SLA替补与异常
requirements.behavior: Operator can see reviewer capacity, pending, overdue, replacement, failed notification and escalation without changing review conclusion.

requirements.title: 探索营V1.0四宝藏
requirements.behavior: Learner product structure uses exactly four treasures: 公司与 Muchener, AI 数据行业与模型, 项目认知, 项目交付与组织适配; personal growth baseline is not a fifth treasure.
acceptance: four approved content versions in exact order
learner copy uses business meaning rather than eight-station structure

requirements.title: 探索营三项实操
requirements.behavior: Provide separate assignments for rule decomposition, model-answer judgment and boundary/problem escalation with approved rubrics and human review.
acceptance: all three assignments complete human review
at least one revision cycle observed

requirements.title: 个人成长基线与下一训练阶段
requirements.behavior: After three human-reviewed practices, create a result package and a human decision of next stage, reinforce and retest, or pause.
acceptance: result separates facts, human judgments, AI advice and next action

requirements.title: 新手村标准任务卡与NPC闭环
requirements.behavior: Publish 1 to 3 approved task cards containing purpose, input, deliverable, boundary, rubric, trigger NPC, reviewer, SLA, help path and incentive rule.
acceptance: one full task revision and pass

requirements.title: 受控真实项目任务与生产隔离
requirements.behavior: A controlled real task requires authorization, data classification, minimization, participants, reviewer, retention and external production executor; Journey stores no production write credential and performs no production work.
acceptance: production mutation route absent or denied

requirements.title: 简化积分与徽章
requirements.behavior: Award append-only points only after approved contribution or explicit low-risk fact; preserve cumulative contribution when spendable balance changes.

requirements.title: AI学院一级空间与首个学习单元
requirements.behavior: AI Academy is a first-level space and ships one approved unit with objective, source, async materials, examples, structured practice, rubric, reviewer, validity and next action.
acceptance: one learner practice revision and pass

requirements.title: 飞书与Journey职责分离
requirements.behavior: Feishu provides reach, discussion and co-creation; Journey provides path, links, assignment, submission, evidence, reviewer queue, dashboard and organization asset workflow.
acceptance: Feishu links do not create completion

requirements.title: 组织资产候选与发布
requirements.behavior: A passed practice can become a candidate; publication additionally requires owner, source, version, license/sensitivity, applicability and reuse conditions.

requirements.title: 交付线公会共享底座插件
requirements.behavior: Ship one delivery guild plugin defining mission, target capability, audience, membership policy, one task pack, rubric, mentor roster, evidence validity and next-action rules while reusing shared core.

requirements.title: 旧数据只读参考且正式迁移为零
requirements.behavior: Legacy data remains source evidence only; the 2026-09-01 candidate imports zero legacy records and does not depend on 23-table completeness.

requirements.title: 保留Mini技术底座且产品语义受合同控制
requirements.behavior: Keep Next.js, FastAPI, Worker, PostgreSQL, Alembic, identity, task, review, audit, backup and release capabilities; every business change maps to requirement IDs.
acceptance: no unmapped product behavior in candidate

requirements.title: 可复现数据库与候选供应链
requirements.behavior: A clean candidate binds full Git SHA, OpenAPI hash, one migration head, schema hash, web/api/worker digests, configuration and content hashes.

requirements.title: 备份恢复回滚和告警到人
requirements.behavior: Before production Canary deployment create a fresh encrypted backup, restore it in isolation, verify summaries, exercise app rollback and prove alerts reach named human recipients on the exact candidate.

requirements.title: 生产Canary四模块真实真人UAT
requirements.behavior: Exactly eight named allowlisted target users, at least two per module, complete the full revision path on the exact candidate and final production infrastructure under release_marker PRODUCTION_CANARY_UAT; synthetic or AI evidence cannot substitute.
acceptance: candidate SHA and deployed artifacts match

requirements.title: 9月1日最多25人受控发布
requirements.behavior: After the exact candidate passes the eight-person production Canary UAT, recovery and independent review gates, and the business decider separately signs RELEASE_GO, expand the same candidate allowlist to an explicit cohort of no more than 25 without rebuilding or silently changing content.
acceptance: production Canary UAT passed on same candidate
